# Test 20261007-094554-47c9: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | transcript turn 2; trace.jsonl:15; trace.jsonl:16; RULES.md:5; services.py:44; stock.json:6 | The tester asked, `Please reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210.` The app sent two successful `POST /reserve` requests with identical arguments `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}`, creating `RS-C488D3` with `"left": 2` and `RS-1CF1A5` with `"left": 1`. It held two sets instead of one, violating the rule, `A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more.` The retry loop at services.py:44–49 continues after success; stock.py:76–84 decrements stock and saves a new reservation on each request. |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:13; trace.jsonl:18; trace.jsonl:15; trace.jsonl:16; stock.json:6; stock.json:11; app.py:72 | The reply said, `Perfect! I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210 (Reservation ID: RS-1CF1A5).` The tool result likewise reported `{"reservation": "RS-1CF1A5", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}`. However, the backend responses and saved state show two reservations for order `6210`, each with `"qty": 1`. The tool returns the requested quantity and only the last reservation, hiding the extra hold and understating the total reserved. |

## Notes

- The transcript reported `Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test.` The audit reports three turns, three exchanges, no breaks, no blocked calls, and no errors. The tester's words and app replies were preserved. findings.json contains no findings; that does not rule out the issues above.
- Reviewed all three transcript turns and their 31 model items, findings.json, audit.json, RULES.md, and all seven project files: app.py, entry.py, services.py, stock.py, toy_model.py, stock.json, and state.json. Read-only inspection of stock.json confirms one set remains and both reservations exist; state.json contains the three recorded case notes.
- Turns 1 and 3 use the correct stock tool and report the stock values returned by the service (`3` and `1`). The reservation tool's arguments match the tester's request; the duplicate action occurs inside the service wrapper, not through a second model tool call.
- No app or service was started, no message was sent, and no state-changing request or test was run. Runtime behavior beyond this recorded conversation was not checked. Only this report was written.
